snippet.title: You're Not Dreaming...We Revived Project Hero
snippet.description:
Watch *LIVE* Mon-Fri! ► https://www.twitch.tv/stelmo98
View More of This Channel! ► https://www.youtube.com/@Stelmo98?sub_confirmation=1
Visit my Second Channel Here! ► https://www.youtube.com/@StelmoShow?sub_confirmation=1
---------------------------------------------
**Not Affiliated With Hero**

Beatz (P-06 dev and veteran Sonic modder) and I initially started this project as just porting some stages into the old Project Hero 2019 build. Quickly though, it turned into it's own beast with tons of new mechanics, polish, and fun. We've called it Project Hero Rewired.

If you LIKE the video, Hit that button! 👍

Check out Beatz's Video on the Project here!: Coming Soon™ (he's been busy polishing the project)

Videos I reference:
https://youtu.be/wKdo5f5X_qc?si=NXYR6dctkj9BoM-A
https://youtu.be/bpwQN0QGVWw?si=oHUidbl22-xOmG1M

Sonic Render made by...me! (with some guidance from ChaosX and Beatz):
https://x.com/Stelmo98

Thanks to Haley for quality checking and starring in the video, was quite the show this time. And yes, the cake was good
---------------------------------------------
Title: You're Not Dreaming...We Revived Project Hero

#sonic35 #sonic #sonicthehedgehog
